config.local_wikipedia.catalog_missing: Kiwix offers no edition for this selection.
config.local_wikipedia.confirm_delete: This removes the edition, any partial download and its state. The agent and the desktop app lose access until you install again.
config.local_wikipedia.confirm_delete_ol: {required} are needed, but only {free} are free. The download fits if the installed edition is deleted first; Wikipedia is then offline until the download is complete. Delete the old edition and continue?
Not enough space for both editions
config.local_wikipedia.confirm_install: {edition} will be downloaded ({size}). Free space: {free}. The download can take hours; an installed edition stays available until the new one is ready.
config.local_wikipedia.confirm_unknown_s: AuraGo cannot determine the free space in the storage directory. Download {size} anyway?
config.local_wikipedia.data_dir_docker: AuraGo runs in Docker, so the edition is always stored in its data volume: {path}
config.local_wikipedia.data_dir_placehol: Empty = wikipedia folder in AuraGo's data directory
config.local_wikipedia.enable_first: Enable Local Wikipedia and save first.
config.local_wikipedia.error_busy: Another Wikipedia operation is running. Wait until it has finished.
config.local_wikipedia.error_catalog_unr: The Kiwix catalog is unreachable. The installed edition keeps working; check the internet connection and retry.
config.local_wikipedia.error_checksum_mi: The download was damaged (checksum mismatch) and has been removed. Install again.
config.local_wikipedia.error_data_dir_in: The storage directory cannot be used. Choose an absolute, writable directory outside system folders.
config.local_wikipedia.error_disabled: Local Wikipedia is switched off. Enable it and save first.
config.local_wikipedia.error_download_fa: All download mirrors failed. Check the internet connection and resume.
config.local_wikipedia.error_download_un: The downloaded file could not be read and was removed. Install again.
config.local_wikipedia.error_free_space_: The free space in the storage directory cannot be determined.
config.local_wikipedia.error_fulltext_un: This edition has no usable full-text index, so search uses article titles only.
config.local_wikipedia.error_insufficien: Not enough free space: {required} needed, {free} available. Free up space or choose another storage directory, then try again.
config.local_wikipedia.error_invalid_req: The server rejected the request as invalid. Reload the page and try again; the AuraGo log has the details.
config.local_wikipedia.error_localwiki_e: Something went wrong. Check the AuraGo log for details.
config.local_wikipedia.error_localwiki_u: Local Wikipedia is not available on this server. Check the AuraGo log for details.
config.local_wikipedia.error_state_unrea: The Local Wikipedia state file could not be read. Install the edition again or delete it.
config.local_wikipedia.error_zim_unreada: The edition file cannot be read. Delete it and install again.
config.local_wikipedia.selection_mismatc: The installed edition does not match your selection. Install replaces it.
config.local_wikipedia.update_check: Check daily for a newer edition
config.local_wikipedia.update_failed: The update failed; the installed edition keeps working.
config.local_wikipedia.warning_size: Depending on language and variant, an edition needs up to 130 GB and the download can take hours.
config.section.local_wikipedia.desc: Offline Wikipedia for the agent and the desktop, read from one downloaded Kiwix edition.
config.section.local_wikipedia.label: Local Wikipedia
help.local_wikipedia.agent_access: Lets the agent search and read the installed edition.
help.local_wikipedia.data_dir: Absolute path for the edition. Leave empty to use the wikipedia folder in AuraGo's data directory.
help.local_wikipedia.enabled: Turns the integration on. Nothing is downloaded until you click Install.
help.local_wikipedia.language: Empty uses the AuraGo system language. Changing it never starts a download.
help.local_wikipedia.update_check: Shows a hint when Kiwix publishes a newer edition. Updates start only when you click Update.
help.local_wikipedia.variant: Without media is much smaller; with media also contains images.
